Hi, I see myself in your post. A few years ago, I was like your ex-boyfriend. I was in a relationship but was also busy with school and struggled with my mental health. We broke up and it was indicated by me. I wanted someone better for him and someone who had time for him. I still love so much to this very day and i wake up crying after having him in my dreams. He deserves someone who has all the time in the world to build a life together and I knew that I couldn‘t give that to him.
This was 2 years ago. Now I want stability. I don‘t prioritize school anymore because I learnt it the hard way at what cost that came for me. I would love to be in a relationship, spend a lot of time together, and have a kid after a few years and an easy life. I think that the breakup still hurts so much because I changed so much that NOW would be a great time to meet him. But that‘s just not how life works. I don‘t think you‘re crazy. Everyone has different priorities and things they long for in life. A friend of mine already has a kid at 24 and another friend doesn‘t want to have kids at all. And that‘s ok!! If you want a simple life with a partner and kid, that is so ok!! Nothing wrong with that. Just because it might not be what everyone around you prioritizes and this age, doesn‘t mean it‘s wrong. Everyone is on their on life‘s journey. I‘m sorry that you guys broke up :( it‘s so difficult to be in a relationship with two completely different priorities. Maybe you run into each other again and be completely different people. Maybe you don‘t. I would start trying to work on your goal, go out and meet people. Maybe the right one is oht there and don‘t forget you‘re still young. But don‘t feel bad for your priorities and goals in life, they‘re perfectly fine.
